scenes.v1: Night on a calm river: a Vietnamese fisherman in a small wooden boat pulling up a fishing net, inside the net a long plain iron blade glows faintly, a burning torch on the boat, reeds and a full moon.
scenes.v2: Close view at night on a river: an amazed Vietnamese fisherman in a brown tunic and conical leaf hat holding up a long bare iron blade with NO handle and NO crossguard, just a plain flat strip of dark iron gripped through a rag, beside a burning torch; the blade shines with soft golden light; dark river and banana leaves behind.
scenes.v3: Occupied land: foreign Ming dynasty soldiers in red-tasseled helmets and lamellar armor leading a line of sad Vietnamese craftsmen and ox carts piled high with books and scrolls along a road, villagers watching sadly from thatched houses, grey sky.
scenes.v4: A dignified Vietnamese landowner in his thirties, with a short beard, dark blue cross-collared tunic and black cloth head wrap, standing calmly in front of a large wooden stilt house in forested green hills, servants and buffalo in the background.
scenes.v5: A secret oath in a forest clearing: nineteen Vietnamese men kneeling in a circle around a small stone altar with burning incense and a bowl, raising their cups together, tall trees and morning mist.
scenes.v7: A huge old banyan tree with hanging roots at dusk; high among its branches a jeweled sword hilt glows with golden light; the Vietnamese leader in a dark blue tunic looks up at it in wonder.
scenes.v8: The Vietnamese leader in a dark blue tunic raising a complete straight double-edged sword that glows golden above his head, his loyal followers with spears and bamboo shields kneeling and cheering around him, banners, sunrise over hills.
scenes.v9: A hungry rebel camp high on a misty mountain in the rain: thin Vietnamese rebel soldiers sitting around a small cooking fire boiling wild roots and banana stems, a tired war elephant standing behind them, bamboo shelters.
scenes.v10: A brave Vietnamese general wearing a bright golden royal robe riding a galloping horse alone out of a forest toward distant enemy lines with red flags, while in the shadows of the trees the real leader in plain brown clothes watches sadly with a few men.
scenes.v11: A wise Vietnamese scholar with a thin beard and black head wrap sitting under a tree, carefully painting on large green leaves with a small brush dipped in a bowl of honey; ants crawling on the leaves; other leaves on the ground with tiny holes eaten through them.
scenes.v12: A narrow mountain pass between very steep limestone cliffs: an army of foreign Ming cavalry with red flags trapped in the valley, Vietnamese rebels with banners appearing on the cliffs on both sides, dramatic sky.
scenes.v13: After the war, a peaceful riverside: the Vietnamese king in a simple golden-yellow robe watching calmly as defeated Ming soldiers, unarmed, board wooden boats and lead horses to go home; Vietnamese soldiers handing them baskets of rice.
scenes.v14: A Vietnamese royal court hall with red wooden columns and dragon carvings: the new king in a golden-yellow robe and a black winged cap seated on a throne, a scholar standing before him reading aloud from a long open scroll, mandarins bowing.
scenes.v15: A green lake in the middle of an old Vietnamese capital city: the king standing on a wooden dragon boat holding out a glowing golden sword, a giant golden turtle rising from the water in front of the boat, willow trees and old tiled roofs around the lake.
scenes.v16: A calm green lake with a small old stone tower on a tiny island in the middle and a red arched wooden bridge on the side; a very large soft-shell turtle surfacing in the water in the foreground; people on the shore watching; sunrise.
